The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The thread is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the river. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
